title: Two Kinds of Birds
sentences: Ducks and robins are both birds.
They both have feathers and wings.
They both lay eggs in a nest.
But they live in different places.
A duck lives near a pond.
It can swim and float on the water.
A robin lives in a tree.
It hops on the grass to find worms.

questions.prompt: How are ducks and robins alike?
options: They both live in a tree.

questions.prompt: How are ducks and robins different?
options: A duck lives near a pond, but a robin lives in a tree.
A duck has wings, but a robin does not.
A duck lays eggs, but a robin does not.

bonus.prompt: Which word means not the same?
